title: How to get rich with AI...
transcript: How can I get from zero to 50K a month with AI? >> I think most people overcomplicate making money with AI. Nobody's ever woken up and said, "Yeah, I got to buy some AI today." They go, "I need to solve this problem." And AI does that. >> Text everybody in your phone and just saying, "Hey, I'm starting AI automation. You know anybody looking?" My 12-year-old came to me and he's like, "I want to start [music] selling AI stuff. How do I do it?" I got him to call all my friends and be like, "What are you working on that you want to automate in business?" >> Yeah. Well, there's this, this, and this. He's like, "If I could automate that, would you pay me?" [music] Yeah. Show me an example. Use AI to create the example. And then Actually, no. He's got people paying him every month. >> You just need to sell something to somebody.
